stakeholders.name: Bauchi Mining Synergy and Exploration Limited (BAMSEL)
stakeholders.description: Responsible for commercial mineral exploration, development and investment partnerships on behalf of Bauchi State.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: State-owned exploration and mining operations, investment facilitation and project development.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Mineral exploration and mining projects within Bauchi State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Conducts mineral prospecting and exploration; manages state equity in mining ventures; partners with private companies; supports job creation and state revenue generation.

stakeholders.name: Benue State Bureau for Solid Minerals
stakeholders.description: Responsible for overseeing state mineral assets, regulating state-level mining activities and supporting state-owned mineral projects.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Regulation, project oversight and state participation in mineral development.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Solid mineral activities within Benue State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Coordinates state-owned mining initiatives; provides governance and oversight; supports licensing, monitoring and mineral resource management.

stakeholders.name: Benue State Geo-Mining Company Nigeria Limited
stakeholders.description: State-owned company responsible for mineral exploration, geological mapping and development of state mineral resources.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Exploration, early-stage resource development and project facilitation.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Mineral exploration and project development across Benue State.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Conducts geological studies, sampling and resource estimation; initiates mining projects; partners with investors; promotes commercial development of priority minerals.

stakeholders.name: Fountain Solid Mineral Development Company (FSMDC)

stakeholders.valueChainRole: State-owned mineral exploration, mining and mineral-based industrial development.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Leads state-backed mineral initiatives; undertakes exploration; partners with private miners; facilitates downstream processing and value addition projects.
